'''H'sishi''' was a [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who joined [[Talon Karrde]]'s organization in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], after assisting [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to escape [[Chay Praysh]] during her attempt to rescue [[Sansia Bardrin]]. She got injured in the process and was immediately taken to Talon Karrde's medical facility. As she healed, Mara Jade told Karrde about how resourceful the Togorian was and Karrde agreed to give her a position in the smuggling operation. H'sishi proved to be a loyal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and a valuable crewmember of the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'', such as when she scared some of [[Rei'Kas]]'s pirates.
